title: Move Camera
summary: Reveal new aspects of a scene by re-staging the camera. Image-to-image: pass `--image <path>` to the generator with a reference shot and the model will hold subject + environment consistent while changing the angle. Default angle is bird's-eye top-down; edit the prompt to try low-angle, dutch tilt, over-the-shoulder, worm's-eye, etc.
prompt: Move the camera to a bird's-eye top-down angle, revealing new aspects of the scene while maintaining the subject and environment consistency.
